elements.element: Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment.
elements.evidence: The clause retains minimum monthly fees, including the Monthly Base Fee, and requires Customer to obtain specified bundled Services from M&I during the Term.

elements.element: Customer pays only for usage or ordered Services.
elements.evidence: Customer remains liable for minimum monthly fees regardless of actual usage, with any usage shortfall settled by a true-up payment.

elements.element: The commitment is limited to the current 12-month term.
elements.evidence: The added language limits Customer's minimum-monthly-fee commitment to the then-current twelve-month period of the Term.

elements.element: Customer may reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: Customer may reduce the commitment and corresponding minimum monthly fees upon thirty days' prior written notice to M&I.

elements.element: Any shortfall is handled through a true-up rather than a penalty.
elements.evidence: Any shortfall must be settled solely by a true-up payment of the difference and not by any penalty.
